objects.description:
[LockBit 3.0](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1202) can enable automatic logon through the `SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows
NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon` Registry key.(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory LockBit 3.0 MAR 2023)
objects.description_fa:
[LockBit 3.0](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1202) می‌تواند ورود خودکار را از طریق «SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows» فعال کند
کلید رجیستری NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon.(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory LockBit 3.0 MAR 2023)
